editorial:
You are finally getting the ogre you have been waiting for! It is great to see Shrek and Donkey back together as they leave the swamp behind for a wild trip to the city of Further Further Away. The vibe is exactly what you remember from the first few movies, mixing silly jokes with a lot of heart. You will love how the movie handles the characters as they get older, making the friendship between the ogre and the talking donkey feel more real than ever. It feels like a big family reunion that does not take itself too seriously, keeping you laughing from the very first scene.

The animation looks stunning, and the pacing is snappy so you never get bored. While a few of the side plots feel a bit rushed, the chemistry between the lead voices is still gold. You should definitely watch this with your kids or your old friends for a cozy movie night.
endingExplained: Everything wraps up when Shrek realizes that the fancy city life is not for him. After defeating the greedy mayor in a big food fight, he decides to move his family back to the swamp for good. The big twist is that Donkey actually finds a way to open his own bakery in the city, so he gets the best of both worlds. Everyone hugs it out and the movie ends with a giant party.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy humor and heartwarming family stories.
